Read-me:

If you are remixing, i advise you not to use any 'Forever' or 'Repeat until" style loops as they will cause massive lag, instead use the 'step' broadcast to call any code that needs to run constantly. This is due to the way i have setup the project to get more speed and control, sorry for any inconvenience. I look forward to seeing what you create!
